project.name: LEGO War Universe
project.target: Google Flow (Veo 3), 8-second cinematic shots, long-form war-film series

styleBlock.name: LWU Master Style
lines: Ultra realistic LEGO stop motion
photorealistic LEGO plastic with real brick textures and subtle mold seams
authentic LEGO minifigure and brick construction
cinematic lighting, movie quality, shot on virtual 35mm anamorphic
shallow depth of field, natural motion blur
8K detail, 24fps cinematic motion
16:9 aspect ratio
Google Flow optimized, Veo optimized
all solid objects are built from LEGO bricks: terrain plates, buildings, vehicles, weapons, props and debris, with visible studs, tubes and mold seams
consistent LEGO minifigure scale across the entire scene
weather, water and combat effects are photorealistic real-world elements, not made of bricks
photoreal rain, snow, fog, mist, clouds, ocean water, rivers and splashes with real fluid simulation
photoreal fire, gun smoke, cordite haze, sparks, embers, shockwaves, dust and mushroom clouds with volumetric lighting
real physical interaction between effects and bricks: wet glossy plastic, snow settling on studs, smoke wrapping around the models
practical-effects look of a high-end LEGO stop motion film shot on a real set

negative.name: LWU Universal Negative Prompt
lines: no extra characters
no duplicated vehicles
no melting or warped LEGO bricks
no broken anatomy
no unrealistic proportions
no blurry or smeared textures
no floating objects
no incorrect military markings
no cartoon exaggeration
no on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no logos
maintain consistent LEGO brick scale
maintain consistent lighting
maintain consistent character appearance
no mixing WWII-era equipment into modern scenes
no anachronistic uniforms or weapons for the selected series
no plastic-looking or brick-built water, rain, snow, fog, smoke or fire
no blocky pixelated explosions, no cartoon puff effects
do not turn solid props, vehicles or terrain into non-LEGO real-world materials
